scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c cyan,green,blue "npm run dev -w @dueltrack/shared" "npm run dev -w @dueltrack/server" "npm run dev -w @dueltrack/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dueltrack/shared && npm run build -w @dueltrack/server && npm run build -w @dueltrack/client
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
